topics: quiet study and tutorial backdrop without vinyl noise
prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for quiet study and tutorial backdrop without vinyl noise. Instruments: soft electric piano, restrained drums, warm bass. 86 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.
